snippet.title: Prison Guard: Warden Simulator — Official Trailer
snippet.description:
📄 Description:
Step into the tough role of a high-security prison guard.
Patrol cell blocks, manage inmates, deal with riots and escape attempts, and make choices that shape order—or chaos. Your actions impact the entire prison.

🔒 Features:
• Realistic prison environment
• Daily tasks & emergencies
• Choice-driven gameplay
• Inmate behavior system
• Career progression

Do you have what it takes to keep control?
#PrisonGuardSimulator #WardenSimulator #IndieGame #SimulationGame
